symptom: `mxcli check -p --references` printed "All references valid" for seven kinds of wrong reference that exec then refused or mxbuild reported (mendixlabs/mxcli#1472): an ALTER PAGE INSERT/REPLACE/DROP target widget and the flows/pages its inserted or replacing widgets name (exec: widget/microflow not found); a DataGrid 2 column Attribute (CE1613); an access rule's WHERE path (CE1613 at the access rule); an entity event handler's microflow (exec: microflow not found); `Module.Enum.Key` in an expression (CE1613 "The selected enumeration value … no longer exists"); and a view entity's FROM/JOIN entity (CE0174 "Cannot resolve object name").
cause: Each statement's reference check stopped at the document or entity level and never looked inside: ALTER PAGE resolved only its document, validateWidgetReferences ran only for CREATE page/layout/snippet, the column scope rule asked only whether a name belonged to ANOTHER entity, grantResolver never parsed the WHERE, neither entity statement looked at its handlers, exprcheck read enum values but never asked whether the key exists, and an unknown OQL source just made its columns untyped (and untyped columns are skipped).
file: mdl/executor/validate_alter_page_refs.go; mdl/executor/validate_datagrid_column_attrs.go; mdl/executor/validate_grant_refs.go (xpathProblem) + validate_retrieve_members.go (scriptXPathResolver); mdl/executor/validate_entity_event_handlers.go; mdl/executor/validate_enum_value_refs.go; mdl/executor/validate_view_source_entities.go; wired from mdl/executor/validate.go
insight: Probe every sibling: the reported kinds were seven faces of one shape — a check that resolves the container and not its contents — and each was closed by reusing what exec or a neighbouring rule already runs (exec's AlterTargetResolver against the stored page, validateWidgetReferences, the retrieve check's XPath walk, extractAliasMap) rather than restating it. Two measurements changed the plan: a DataGrid 2 header filter's Attribute is never written by the column builder (describe prints a bare `textfilter`, mxbuild is silent), so refusing a misspelt one would refuse a script that builds; and pedapp sits at security level Off, where mxbuild skips access rules entirely — the access-rule CE1613 only appears after `alter project security level prototype`. The pedapp control for the grant WHERE also caught a latent false refusal in the shared XPath resolver: an entity the script ALTERs was judged from its stored attribute list.
